'''Albert Reyes Roig''' (born 24 March 1996) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] for [[CE Casa de Portugal|Casa de Portugal]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{WorldFootball.net}}</ref>

==Career==
Reyes made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 7 October 2020 in a [[Exhibition game|friendly]] match against [[Cape Verde national football team|Cape Verde]], which finished as a 1–2 home loss.<ref name="EUF">{{cite web |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=31121 |title=Albert Reyes |website=EU-Football.info |access-date=7 October 2020}}</ref>
